jobs.title: Full Stack AI Engineer
jobs.location: Remote(Everywhere), Full-time AiMi builds agentic AI infrastructure for capital markets: autonomous agents that ingest venue and vendor notifications, assess impact across client infrastructure, and drive change management workflows in real time, replacing what used to be manual, static processes for exchanges and their ops teams. live production platform, not a pilot. you'd work across the full stack: React/TypeScript frontend, Node.js backend, AWS Lambda. concretely: shipping features in the agent pipeline, building MCP-based connectors and skills that extend what our agents can reach, running evals on agent accuracy and reliability, building observability and alerting for agent latency/error rates/failed workflows, and making long-running LLM, agent, and SSE calls actually resilient (timeouts, retries, circuit breakers, fail-fast, recovery). also a fair amount of diagnosing dependency/version conflicts in a Node.js/npm monorepo, which is its own skill. looking for 2-3+ years hands-on experience, solid Node.js and REST API background, real hands-on work with LLMs or agent frameworks (Mastra, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Claude, OpenAI or similar), comfortable with AWS (Lambda, Bedrock, DynamoDB, S3, Cognito, API Gateway, CloudWatch), MongoDB/DynamoDB, and genuinely tests what you ship (unit, integration, e2e). familiarity with spec-driven development (Claude Code, Cursor, CodeRabbit or similar) is a real plus since that's how we work day to day. bonus points for capital markets/trading infra background, LLM observability tooling like Langfuse, SSE streaming experience, or PostHog. you'd be working on great things here: real architectural decisions at an early-stage company, visible impact from week one, and room to grow into a senior or lead role as we grow. apply: https://join.com/companies/aimitechnology/16658631-agentic-a... , or reach out directly at vishnu.swaroop@aimi.technology

jobs.title: Staff, Analytics Engineer, GTM Data Science & Analytics
Data Scientist, Classification and Scoring
jobs.location: REMOTE: North America / Europe, UTC-8 to UTC+2, Full-time Lokker is a privacy platform. We continuously analyze websites, applications, third-party technologies and data flows to identify privacy, security and consent risks in production. We have built a large proprietary dataset from years of observing real-world digital behavior, and we are hiring a data scientist to help us expand and improve the classification, scoring and risk intelligence built on it. You will develop and improve models that classify digital activity, identify meaningful privacy and security behaviors, and assess the confidence and significance of findings. Looking for 2 to 4 years of production experience in data science and machine learning. Strong Python and SQL, pandas or Polars, scikit-learn and modern classification techniques, familiarity with model evaluation and explainability. Practical experience in training and evaluating supervised classification models on real PRODUCTION data, practical LLM experience beyond simple demonstrations, and curiosity about how websites and internet technologies actually behave. You do not need a privacy or adtech background. We will teach the domain. You will work closely with engineering, product and privacy experts, and what you build goes directly into the product. IMPORTANT: the timezone range above is a hard requirement, not a preference. We cannot make an exception. ON APPLICATIONS: we assume you used AI to help write it. So do we. What we cannot do is verify a claim that exists only in the document you sent us, so make sure the skills you claim are visible somewhere public: LinkedIn with real dates and role detail, GitHub, papers, Kaggle, a writeup, a talk. If your best work is under NDA, say so and describe it in your own words. A human reads every application. No keyword filter, no automated rejection. Apply: https://lokker.com/careers/openings/data-scientist-classific...

jobs.location: REMOTE (EU timezones), Full-time, https://cloro.dev/careers/ cloro is one API for search and AI answers. You send a query, we return Google, Google News, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Grok and Copilot results as structured fields: the answer, the sources it cited, and the position each result held. Teams use it to measure whether their brand shows up in AI answers, and to stop maintaining eight scrapers that break whenever a provider changes its markup overnight. We are bootstrapped, remote across EU timezones, and small enough that every role below works directly with the founders. Open roles: * Founding Engineer, backend and infra, heavy on large-scale collection. https://cloro.dev/careers/founding-engineer/ * Data Scientist, turn our AI-search corpus into published research and track the engines as they change. https://cloro.dev/careers/data-scientist/ * Founding Operations, finance, ops, marketing and product systems. An all-rounder role for someone who would rather build a system than run a task twice. https://cloro.dev/careers/founding-operations/ * Founding Marketer, own SEO, content, and visibility in AI search. https://cloro.dev/careers/founding-marketer/ We work AI-native: Claude and Claude Code are in the loop daily across engineering, ops and marketing. Being genuinely good with these tools is part of the job rather than a bonus.
